Instrument.name: Mars 2020 Perseverance Rover Engineering Camera Suite
Instrument.description: The Mars 2020 Perseverance Rover Engineering Camera Suite (ECAM) is comprised of nine (9) camera imaging systems that aid the rover in navigating the Martian terrain and avoiding obstacles therein. Additionally, a CacheCam is used to verify the collection of surface samples acquired during the mission. The full complement of instruments and cameras contained within the Engineering Camera Suite are: (1) HazCam: Hazard Avoidance Cameras (six (6) cameras total) (a) two front-facing stereo pairs, (b) one rear-facing stereo pair, (2) NavCam: Navigation Cameras (one stereo pair mounted to the rover mast), (3) CacheCam: Sample Caching System Camera (one single monocular camera system).
